### From `packages/core/src/manifest.ts`

#### <a id="core-manifestpatch"></a>`ManifestPatch`

const, type · declared in `packages/core/src/manifest.ts`

#### <a id="core-mentionhover"></a>`MentionHover`

const, type · declared in `packages/core/src/manifest.ts`

What a person sees when hovering a mention. `value` is the thing as its declared type, so the card offers its methods.

```ts
type MentionHover = {
  title: string;
  subtitle?: string | undefined;
  fields?: {
    label: string;
    value: string;
  }[] | undefined;
  body?: string | undefined;
  open?: {
    resource: `${string}://${string}`;
    section?: SectionKey | undefined;
    title?: string | undefined;
  } | {
    url: string;
    title: string;
  } | {
    file: {
      hash: string;
      size: number;
      mime: string;
    };
    title: string;
  } | {
    run: string;
    title: string;
  } | undefined;
  value?: z.core.util.JSONType | undefined;
};
```

#### <a id="core-sectiondecl"></a>`SectionDecl`

type · declared in `packages/core/src/manifest.ts`

The declaration type of one manifest section.

```ts
type SectionDecl<S extends ManifestSection> = z.infer<(typeof MANIFEST_SECTIONS)[S]>;
```

#### <a id="core-typedecl"></a>`TypeDecl`

const, type · declared in `packages/core/src/manifest.ts`

A named type. Its methods are sent as fns named `Type.method` whose args hold the value as `self`.

```ts
type TypeDecl = {
  name: string;
  description: string;
  def: TypeDef<any>;
  display: {
    label: string;
    plural?: string | undefined;
    icon?: string | undefined;
    color?: string | undefined;
    title?: string | undefined;
    subtitle?: string | undefined;
  };
  methods: string[];
  instance?: InstanceName | undefined;
  audience?: {
    visibility: "private" | "shared" | "public";
    with: string[];
  } | undefined;
  meta?: Record<string, z.core.util.JSONType> | undefined;
  records?: {
    shape: "table" | "value";
    owner: "shared" | "person";
    search: {
      text: string[];
      embed: boolean;
    };
    writers?: "admins" | undefined;
  } | undefined;
};
```
